mechanism: Both drugs inhibit norepinephrine reuptake and have anticholinergic effects; atomoxetine is metabolized by CYP2D6 which amitriptyline inhibits, increasing atomoxetine levels and risk of toxicity.
action: Monitor closely for increased atomoxetine adverse effects (tachycardia, tremor, insomnia); consider dose reduction of atomoxetine or use alternative antidepressant; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
